conditionThreshold.filter: metric.type="run.googleapis.com/job/completed_execution_count" AND resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name="__JOB_NAME__" AND metric.labels.result="failed"

documentation.content: The verification job __JOB_NAME__ found a problem with the newest backup (or could not run). See the FAIL lines in `make logs JOB=verify`; the last line counts passed, warnings and failed checks. A FAIL on "age" means no complete backup was made recently: check the backup job's own emails and `make executions`.
